answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by scoring identities from the structure of their endorsement graph rather than certifying each one separately. Genuine members form a sparse web of real interactions, while a sybil farm collapses into a dense cluster that endorses only itself. A spectral measure discounts any account whose links point inward to its own clique, so a thousand clones cannot push reputation outward. Legitimate standing looks like a lone ivory tower rising from honest work, distinct as a dune ridge, while the fakes are an umber smear of self-references the ledger ignores.
